property_summary: After the owner calls OpenToThePublic, any external EOA caller (msg.sender == tx.origin) can place a wager at the configured bet limit without reverting; the mutant leaves openToPublic false so every wager reverts.
change_summary: Replace `openToPublic = true;` with `openToPublic = false;` so the flag stays false (and can never become true via this function).
